## What this changes

One or two lines.

## Checklist

- [ ] The sample is invented: no real company, person, email, account or invoice.
- [ ] `node scripts/check.mjs` is clean on my machine.
- [ ] If I changed a sample, I recounted `answer-key.md` by hand and ran `node scripts/check.mjs --relock <id>`.
- [ ] New runs are pasted unedited, and the card names the models it was checked on and not checked on.
- [ ] Nothing in the prompt or the skill moves money, sends anything, or contacts anyone without a yes for that exact item.
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0 (recipes) and MIT (code).
